title: Rusted Zeppelin Over Gothic City
description: A massive, rusted green oval airship with riveted metal plating and dangling cables hovers above a dark, intricate gothic cityscape. In the foreground, a lone cloaked figure stands on a metal platform overlooking the scene under a large full moon in a twilight sky.
prompt: A colossal rusted green oval steampunk airship with heavy metal plating, rivets, and dangling cables hovers on a thick support tower above a sprawling intricate gothic city with countless spires.
